lead_raw_text:
The structure of Sc2Fe12Cd2 (reduced formula ScFe6Cd) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cd and Sc centers each coordinated by 12 neighbors in close-packed-like local arrangements, while Fe centers display 12- and 14-neighbor environments. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and fully connected across all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Fe-centered 12- and 14-vertex coordination polyhedra, as well as corner- and edge-sharing between Cd- and Fe-centered 12-vertex polyhedra.
